items.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
items.summary: We’re expanding our ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to offer 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to our frontier models.

items.title: Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse with new tools and support
items.summary: New tools, practical guidance, and partnerships will help prevent, detect and respond to online child sexual exploitation and abuse.

items.title: Science at the Frontier: How scientists use ChatGPT
items.summary: Explore how more than 1,800 scientists use ChatGPT in research. See findings on daily workflows, reported productivity, and expectations for discovery.

items.title: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI
items.summary: LVMH’s Media Division and OpenAI announce a partnership to support journalism with AI and make its publications more accessible through ChatGPT.

items.title: Our first phase of embedded assessments
items.summary: OpenAI begins embedded assessments with Apollo Research, METR, and Transluce, and Goodfire to independently evaluate model alignment, safeguards, and monitoring systems.

items.title: Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams
More ways to move care forward with ChatGPT for Healthcare
items.summary: Introducing computer-use agents, improved clinical answers, and new healthcare plugins that work across healthcare software to get real work done.
